subject: social batteries
caption: Which battery are you? For most people it isn't one. It's a rotation. Save this and send it to the friend who never replies.

beats.text: There are four kinds of social battery. One of them never needs charging.
Charges anywhere, depending on the week you've had.
Fully charged, then completely done, with no warning at all.
Most people are the middle two. You're not broken. You're just social in a different order.
Follow for the stuff nobody teaches you.
